text:
ravi: Heads up — onboard canary for auklet-v1-int8 produced a tools array containing an empty object (`[{}]`) for a funcall. downstream runtime exploded when trying to read .name. stacktrace attached. :(

ravi: scenario: user asks 'Get top headlines for New York' and model should call news_fetch tool
ravi: model raw output captured:
```json
{"type":"tool_call","tools":[{}]}
```

nika: wow. different failure mode than empty array — we get a singleton object with missing name. could be token collapse of the name string into zero-width or tokenizer emitting only structural tokens.

omar: grabbed canary logs, sample entries:
[2026-03-23T09:01:10Z] INFO resp: {"type":"tool_call","tools":[{}]}
[2026-03-23T09:01:11Z] INFO resp: {"type":"tool_call","tools":[{"name":"news_fetch","args":{"q":"NYC"}}]}
[2026-03-23T09:01:13Z] INFO resp: {"type":"tool_call","tools":[{}]}

qa-bot: Telemetry: metric `toolcall.malformed_tool_object.count` spiked to 27 in last 5m for auklet-v1-int8 canary.

nika: repro curl (canary endpoint):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY" -d '{"model":"auklet-v1-int8","input":"Get top headlines for New York"}' https://canary.redwood/api/invoke | jq
```

ravi: quick local sample: ~4/100 calls show malformed object. frequency higher on certain prompts with trailing punctuation.

omar: I pulled raw token streams for failing cases `s3://redwood-canaries/auklet-v1-int8/fails/` — here's token ids around the tool name (redacted):
TOK: [5021, 198, 0, 0, 0, 13, 401]
looks like multiple 0 tokens in a row — maybe an int8 kernel mask/pack bug causing null tokens to be emitted and validator to drop the name string.

nika: immediate mitigations:
- strict schema check: treat any tool object missing `name` as invalid — trigger soft-rescue retry asking model to reemit a complete tool object.
- router-level fallback to auklet-v1-fp16 for responses with malformed tool objects.
- runtime defensive parsing: ignore tool entries without name instead of crashing (log and surface telemetry).

ravi: I implemented a hotfix in router to drop malformed tool objects and prompt the model to reemit: "Your previous tool_call included an empty tool object. Please reply with a tool_call where each tool has a 'name' string and 'args' object." Rolling to 20% now.

omar: with that, 1000 quick calls produced 0 crashes, and qa-bot saw reemit rate of ~85% success on first retry.

qa-bot: Added unit tests to onboarding smoke harness: sample auklet-v1-int8 under jittered prompts and validate tool objects always have name+args. Failing runs upload token streams for triage.

nika: long-term action items:
- runtime team to inspect int8 packing kernels for potential zero-token emission on some micro-batches. pair with infra to reproduce on same hardware.
- add schema rule: tool objects MUST have non-empty `name` and `args` (args may be {}). Log violation with sample tokenids.
- expand evals to include targeted prompts with trailing punctuation/quotes and multisentence requests to catch tokenizer boundary issues.

ravi: creating GH issue RW-issues/3261 with checklist: hotfix rollout, schema rule PR, onboarding test, tokenstream retention flag, kernel bisect. Assigning omar+nika.

infra-bot: Router hotfix rolled to 20% for auklet-v1-int8. Observability rule created: alert if `toolcall.malformed_tool_object.count > 10` in 5m. Will auto-fallback to fp16 pool if threshold breached.

omar: I'll start a bisect job across int8 kernel variants Monday. sharing a lab repro script in the issue.

ravi: thanks all — prioritize the kernel bisect and schema enforcement. Good catch, team. :rocket:
